about: False alarms of the leak scanners that the owner reviewed and decided. Each entry is as narrow as the case: one value (by its SHA-256, so the value itself is never written here), one place. Anything not listed still refuses. Decision: .agents/decisions/2026-10-03_ambiguity-fails-closed.md, addendum 1.

commit_identities.what: the maintainer's public git identity (`name <email>`, lower-case), author and committer of every commit of this public repository
commit_identities.why: the identity the public history already carries on every commit; any other identity in a commit is scanned like a blob

commit_trailer_addresses.what: the AI assistant's public bot address, in `Co-Authored-By:` trailer lines of commit messages
commit_trailer_addresses.why: a published no-reply address of a bot, not a person or an organisation of the owner
